items.q: A new date replies slowly but always plans the next meet-up.
items.why: Actions (making plans) say more than reply speed.

items.q: Someone is lovely in private but ignores you in public.
items.why: Inconsistency between private and public is worth a calm conversation.

options: Notice if you only fit in late-night slots
They're a night owl, nothing more
items.why: Late-night-only contact can mean you're an option, not a priority. Watch the pattern.

items.q: They ask lots of questions about your day.
They disappear for a week, then act like nothing happened.
items.why: Breadcrumbing gives just enough attention to keep you hooked.

items.q: They say 'let's take it slow' after a month.
options: Fair: ask what slow means to them

items.q: They keep score of who paid last.
options: A values chat about money is due

items.q: After a disagreement, they come back with 'I've been thinking about what you said'.
items.why: Coming back to repair after a fight is one of the healthiest signs there is.
